-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, N', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
),
plan_data AS (
    SELECT
        dso.ID AS offering_id,
        jt.doiTuongChaoBan,
        jt.loaiChaoBan,
        jt.soLuongCb,
        jt.giaCb,
        jt.giaTriCbTheoMenhGia,
        jt.soLuongNguoiCb,
        jt.mucDichHoanDoi,
        jt.moTaDoiTuong,
        jt.duKienTuNgay,
        jt.duKienDenNgay
    FROM SCMS_UAT.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING dso
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dso.PLAN_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            doiTuongChaoBan VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.doiTuongChaoBan',
            loaiChaoBan VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.loaiChaoBan',
            soLuongCb NUMBER PATH '$.soLuongCb',
            giaCb NUMBER PATH '$.giaCb',
            giaTriCbTheoMenhGia NUMBER PATH '$.giaTriCbTheoMenhGia',
            soLuongNguoiCb NUMBER PATH '$.soLuongNguoiCb',
            mucDichHoanDoi VARCHAR2(2000) PATH '$.mucDichHoanDoi',
            moTaDoiTuong VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.moTaDoiTuong',
            duKienTuNgay VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.duKienTuNgay',
            duKienDenNgay VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.duKienDenNgay'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE dso.SECURITIES_TYPE IN ('CP_PHO_THONG', 'CP_UU_DAI')
),
result_data AS (
    SELECT
        dso.ID AS offering_id,
        SUM(jt.soLuongThucTe) AS tong_sl_da_cb,
        SUM(jt.giaTriThucTe) AS tong_so_tien_thu_duoc
    FROM SCMS_UAT.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING dso
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dso.RESULT_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            soLuongThucTe NUMBER PATH '$.soLuongThucTe',
            giaTriThucTe  NUMBER PATH '$.giaTriThucTe'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE dso.SECURITIES_TYPE IN ('CP_PHO_THONG', 'CP_UU_DAI')
    GROUP BY dso.ID
),
capital_data AS (
    SELECT
        dso.ID AS offering_id,
        jt.boSungVonMgck,
        jt.boSungVonTuDoanh,
        jt.boSungVonBaoLanhPh,
        jt.boSungVonTuVanDauTu,
        jt.boSungVonVayMargin,
        jt.boSungVonUngTruoc,
        jt.suDungMucDichKhac,
        jt.mucDichCuThe,
        jt.soTienMucDichKhac
    FROM SCMS_UAT.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING dso
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dso.CAPITAL_USE_RESULT_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            boSungVonMgck NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonMgck',
            boSungVonTuDoanh NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonTuDoanh',
            boSungVonBaoLanhPh NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonBaoLanhPh',
            boSungVonTuVanDauTu NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonTuVanDauTu',
            boSungVonVayMargin NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonVayMargin',
            boSungVonUngTruoc NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonUngTruoc',
            suDungMucDichKhac NUMBER PATH '$.suDungMucDichKhac',
            mucDichCuThe VARCHAR2(2000) PATH '$.mucDichCuThe',
            soTienMucDichKhac NUMBER PATH '$.soTienMucDichKhac'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE dso.SECURITIES_TYPE IN ('CP_PHO_THONG', 'CP_UU_DAI')
)
SELECT
    -- CHIỀU / BỘ LỌC
    f.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
    f.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(dso.DOCUMENT_DATE, TRUNC(dso.CREATED_AT))) AS nam_du_lieu,
    CASE dso.SECURITIES_TYPE
        WHEN 'CP_PHO_THONG' THEN 'CP phổ thông'
        WHEN 'CP_UU_DAI' THEN 'CP ưu đãi'
    END AS loai_ck,
    -- 2. Kế hoạch chào bán - Phương án
    pd.doiTuongChaoBan AS "Đối tượng chào bán",
    pd.loaiChaoBan AS "Hình thức chào bán",
    pd.soLuongCb AS "Số lượng cổ phiếu chào bán",
    pd.giaCb AS "Giá cổ phiếu chào bán",
    pd.giaTriCbTheoMenhGia AS "Giá trị CB",
    pd.soLuongNguoiCb AS "SL người CB",
    pd.mucDichHoanDoi AS "Mục đích hoán đổi",
    pd.moTaDoiTuong AS "Mô tả đối tượng",
    pd.duKienTuNgay AS "Thời gian dự kiến (từ ngày)",
    pd.duKienDenNgay AS "Thời gian dự kiến (đến ngày)",
    dso.TOTAL_OFFERED_QUANTITY AS "Tổng SL chào bán",
    dso.EXPECTED_TOTAL_AMOUNT AS "Tổng số tiền dự kiến thu được",
    -- 3. Thông tin VB chấp thuận UBCKNN
    dso.DOCUMENT_NUMBER AS "Số VB chấp thuận",
    TO_CHAR(dso.DOCUMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Ngày VB",
    dso.DOCUMENT_FILE_PATH AS "File VB",
    -- Kết quả chào bán / phát hành
    TO_CHAR(dso.RESULT_REPORT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Ngày báo cáo kết quả",
        TO_CHAR(dso.EXTENSION_TO_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Gia hạn đến ngày",
    dso.ASSESSMENT AS "Đánh giá",
        TO_CHAR(dso.OFFERING_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Ngày bắt đầu CB",
        TO_CHAR(dso.OFFERING_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Ngày kết thúc CB",
    rd.tong_sl_da_cb AS "Tổng SL đã CB",
    rd.tong_so_tien_thu_duoc AS "Tổng số tiền thu được",
    -- Phương án sử dụng vốn
    cd.boSungVonMgck AS "Bổ sung vốn cho MGCK",
    cd.boSungVonTuDoanh AS "Bổ sung vốn cho Tự doanh CK",
    cd.boSungVonBaoLanhPh AS "Bổ sung vốn cho Bảo lãnh PH CK",
    cd.boSungVonTuVanDauTu AS "Bổ sung vốn cho Tư vấn đầu tư",
    cd.boSungVonVayMargin AS "Bổ sung vốn cho vay margin",
    cd.boSungVonUngTruoc AS "Bổ sung vốn cho Ứng trước tiền bán",
    cd.suDungMucDichKhac AS "Sử dụng vào mục đích khác",
    cd.mucDichCuThe AS "Mục đích cụ thể",
    cd.soTienMucDichKhac AS "Số tiền mục đích khác",
    -- Thông tin khác
    dso.UNDERWRITING_COMPANY AS "Tổ chức thực hiện bảo lãnh",
    dso.RESULT_ATTACHMENT_PATH AS "File đính kèm",
    dso.NOTE AS "Ghi chú"
FROM SCMS_UAT.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING dso
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = dso.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = f.ID
LEFT JOIN plan_data pd ON pd.offering_id = dso.ID
LEFT JOIN result_data rd ON rd.offering_id = dso.ID
LEFT JOIN capital_data cd ON cd.offering_id = dso.ID
WHERE dso.SECURITIES_TYPE IN ('CP_PHO_THONG', 'CP_UU_DAI')
ORDER BY f.NAME_VI, dso.DOCUMENT_DATE DESC;

                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, N', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
),
plan_data AS (
    SELECT
        dso.ID AS offering_id,
        jt.doiTuongChaoBan,
        jt.loaiChaoBan,
        jt.soLuongCb,
        jt.giaCb,
        jt.giaTriCbTheoMenhGia,
        jt.moTaDoiTuong,
        jt.duKienTuNgay,
        jt.duKienDenNgay
    FROM SCMS_UAT.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING dso
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dso.PLAN_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            doiTuongChaoBan VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.doiTuongChaoBan',
            loaiChaoBan VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.loaiChaoBan',
            soLuongCb NUMBER PATH '$.soLuongCb',
            giaCb NUMBER PATH '$.giaCb',
            giaTriCbTheoMenhGia NUMBER PATH '$.giaTriCbTheoMenhGia',
            moTaDoiTuong VARCHAR2(4000) PATH '$.moTaDoiTuong',
            duKienTuNgay VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.duKienTuNgay',
            duKienDenNgay VARCHAR2(20) PATH '$.duKienDenNgay'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE dso.SECURITIES_TYPE LIKE '%TP%'
),
result_data AS (
    SELECT
        dso.ID AS offering_id,
        SUM(jt.soLuongThucTe) AS tong_sl_da_cb,
        SUM(jt.giaTriThucTe) AS tong_so_tien_thu_duoc
    FROM SCMS_UAT.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING dso
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dso.RESULT_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            soLuongThucTe NUMBER PATH '$.soLuongThucTe',
            giaTriThucTe  NUMBER PATH '$.giaTriThucTe'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE dso.SECURITIES_TYPE LIKE '%TP%'
    GROUP BY dso.ID
),
capital_data AS (
    SELECT
        dso.ID AS offering_id,
        jt.boSungVonMgck,
        jt.boSungVonTuDoanh,
        jt.boSungVonBaoLanhPh,
        jt.boSungVonTuVanDauTu,
        jt.boSungVonVayMargin,
        jt.boSungVonUngTruoc,
        jt.suDungMucDichKhac,
        jt.mucDichCuThe,
        jt.soTienMucDichKhac
    FROM SCMS_UAT.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING dso
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dso.CAPITAL_USE_RESULT_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            boSungVonMgck NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonMgck',
            boSungVonTuDoanh NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonTuDoanh',
            boSungVonBaoLanhPh NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonBaoLanhPh',
            boSungVonTuVanDauTu NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonTuVanDauTu',
            boSungVonVayMargin NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonVayMargin',
            boSungVonUngTruoc NUMBER PATH '$.boSungVonUngTruoc',
            suDungMucDichKhac NUMBER PATH '$.suDungMucDichKhac',
            mucDichCuThe VARCHAR2(2000) PATH '$.mucDichCuThe',
            soTienMucDichKhac NUMBER PATH '$.soTienMucDichKhac'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE dso.SECURITIES_TYPE LIKE '%TP%'
)
SELECT
    -- CHIỀU / BỘ LỌC
    f.NAME_VI AS ten_ctck,
    f.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,
    EXTRACT(YEAR FROM COALESCE(dso.DOCUMENT_DATE, TRUNC(dso.CREATED_AT))) AS nam_du_lieu,
    dso.BOND_TYPE AS "Loại trái phiếu",
    dso.BOND_FACE_VALUE AS "Mệnh giá TP",
    dso.BOND_CODE AS "Mã trái phiếu",
    dso.MATURITY_YEARS AS "Kỳ hạn (năm)",
    dso.INTEREST_PAYMENT_PERIOD AS "Kỳ trả lãi",
    dso.BOND_HOLDER_REPRESENTATIVE AS "Đại diện NSH TP",
    CASE dso.COLLATERAL_REQUIRED
        WHEN 1 THEN 'Có'
        WHEN 0 THEN 'Không'
    END AS "Có tài sản bảo đảm",   
    -- 2. Kế hoạch chào bán - Phương án
    pd.doiTuongChaoBan AS "Đối tượng chào bán",
    pd.loaiChaoBan AS "Hình thức chào bán",
    pd.soLuongCb AS "Số lượng CB",
    pd.giaCb AS "Giá CB",
    pd.giaTriCbTheoMenhGia AS "Giá trị CB",
    pd.moTaDoiTuong AS "Mô tả đối tượng",
    pd.duKienTuNgay AS "Thời gian dự kiến (từ ngày)",
    pd.duKienDenNgay AS "Thời gian dự kiến (đến ngày)",
    dso.TOTAL_OFFERED_QUANTITY AS "Tổng SL chào bán",
    dso.EXPECTED_TOTAL_AMOUNT AS "Tổng số tiền dự kiến thu được",
    -- 3. Thông tin VB chấp thuận UBCKNN
    dso.DOCUMENT_NUMBER AS "Số VB chấp thuận",
    TO_CHAR(dso.DOCUMENT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Ngày VB",
    dso.DOCUMENT_FILE_PATH AS "File VB",
    -- Kết quả chào bán / phát hành
    TO_CHAR(dso.RESULT_REPORT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Ngày báo cáo kết quả",
	TO_CHAR(dso.EXTENSION_TO_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Gia hạn đến ngày",
    dso.ASSESSMENT AS "Đánh giá",
	TO_CHAR(dso.OFFERING_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Ngày bắt đầu CB",
	TO_CHAR(dso.OFFERING_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "Ngày kết thúc CB",
    rd.tong_sl_da_cb AS "Tổng SL đã CB",
    rd.tong_so_tien_thu_duoc AS "Tổng số tiền thu được",
    -- Phương án sử dụng vốn
    cd.boSungVonMgck AS "Bổ sung vốn cho MGCK",
    cd.boSungVonTuDoanh AS "Bổ sung vốn cho Tự doanh CK",
    cd.boSungVonBaoLanhPh AS "Bổ sung vốn cho Bảo lãnh PH CK",
    cd.boSungVonTuVanDauTu AS "Bổ sung vốn cho Tư vấn đầu tư",
    cd.boSungVonVayMargin AS "Bổ sung vốn cho vay margin",
    cd.boSungVonUngTruoc AS "Bổ sung vốn cho Ứng trước tiền bán",
    cd.suDungMucDichKhac AS "Sử dụng vào mục đích khác",
    cd.mucDichCuThe AS "Mục đích cụ thể",
    cd.soTienMucDichKhac AS "Số tiền mục đích khác",
    -- Thông tin khác
    dso.UNDERWRITING_COMPANY AS "Tổ chức thực hiện bảo lãnh",
    dso.RESULT_ATTACHMENT_PATH AS "File đính kèm",
    dso.NOTE AS "Ghi chú"
FROM SCMS_UAT.DISCLOSURE_SECURITIES_OFFERING dso
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO f ON f.ID = dso.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = f.ID
LEFT JOIN plan_data pd ON pd.offering_id = dso.ID
LEFT JOIN result_data rd ON rd.offering_id = dso.ID
LEFT JOIN capital_data cd ON cd.offering_id = dso.ID
WHERE dso.SECURITIES_TYPE LIKE '%TP%'
ORDER BY f.NAME_VI, dso.DOCUMENT_DATE DESC;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH output_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id, fr.REPORT_CODE, fr.REPORT_NAME
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'DTDK_CN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'OUTPUT'
),
-- Cấu hình chỉ tiêu của báo cáo đầu ra
output_cells AS (
    SELECT
        fs.ID AS form_sheet_id,
        fs.SHEET_CODE, fs.SHEET_NAME,
        fscell.ID AS cell_id,
        fscell.FORM_REPORT_ID,
        fscell.CELL_CODE,
        fscell.DATA_TYPE,
        fscell.FORMULA_TEXT,
        jt.formula_key,
        jt.member_profile_type,
        jt.field_of_member,
        jt.loai_du_lieu_bc,
        jt.bang_du_lieu_bc,
        jt.cot_du_lieu_bc
    FROM output_form of_
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET fs ON fs.FORM_REPORT_ID = of_.form_report_id
    LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET_CELL fscell ON fscell.FORM_SHEET_ID = fs.ID
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        fscell.FORMULA, '$'
        COLUMNS (
            formula_key VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].key',
            member_profile_type VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].memberProfileType',
            field_of_member VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].fieldOfMember',
            loai_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].loaiDuLieuBc',
            bang_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].bangDuLieuBc',
            cot_du_lieu_bc  VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cotDuLieuBc'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE fscell.ID IS NOT NULL
      AND jt.member_profile_type = 'LS_CN_CTCK'
),
-- Lấy dữ liệu từ SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE, parse AFTER_DATA_JSON
profile_change AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ID AS change_id,
        pc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID,
        pc.ENTITY_TYPE,
        -- Parse các trường từ AFTER_DATA_JSON
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.id') AS cn_id,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenCtck') AS tenCtck,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenDayDu') AS tenDayDu,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.diaChi') AS diaChi,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.dienThoai') AS dienThoai,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.giamDoc') AS giamDoc,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.nganhNgheKinhDoanh') AS nganhNgheKinhDoanh,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenTrangThaiChiNhanh') AS tenTrangThaiChiNhanh
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE pc
    WHERE pc.ENTITY_TYPE = 'CN'   -- Chi nhánh
),
nghiep_vu_cn AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ID AS change_id,
        LISTAGG(jt.label, ', ') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY jt.ord) AS nganh_nghe_cn
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE pc
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.nghiepVuUyQuyenSelected[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            ord   FOR ORDINALITY,
            label VARCHAR2(500) PATH '$.label'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE pc.ENTITY_TYPE = 'CN'
    GROUP BY pc.ID
)
SELECT
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, pc.change_id) AS stt_ctck,
    -- CHIỀU / BỘ LỌC
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nvcn.nganh_nghe_cn AS nganh_nghe,
    pc.change_id,
    pc.ENTITY_TYPE,
    -- GIÁ TRỊ
    oc.FORMULA_TEXT AS ma_chi_tieu,
    oc.field_of_member AS ten_chi_tieu,
    CASE oc.field_of_member
        WHEN 'tenCtck' THEN pc.tenCtck
        WHEN 'tenDayDu' THEN pc.tenDayDu
        WHEN 'diaChi' THEN pc.diaChi
        WHEN 'dienThoai' THEN pc.dienThoai
        WHEN 'giamDoc' THEN pc.giamDoc
        WHEN 'nganhNgheKinhDoanh' THEN nvcn.nganh_nghe_cn
        WHEN 'tenTrangThaiChiNhanh' THEN pc.tenTrangThaiChiNhanh
        ELSE NULL
    END AS gia_tri
FROM profile_change pc
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = pc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nghiep_vu_cn nvcn ON nvcn.change_id = pc.change_id
CROSS JOIN output_cells oc
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, pc.change_id, oc.cell_id;

WITH output_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id, fr.REPORT_CODE, fr.REPORT_NAME
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'DTDK_PGD'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'OUTPUT'
),
-- Cấu hình chỉ tiêu của báo cáo đầu ra
output_cells AS (
    SELECT
        fs.ID AS form_sheet_id,
        fs.SHEET_CODE, fs.SHEET_NAME,
        fscell.ID AS cell_id,
        fscell.FORM_REPORT_ID,
        fscell.CELL_CODE,
        fscell.DATA_TYPE,
        fscell.FORMULA_TEXT,
        jt.formula_key,
        jt.member_profile_type,
        jt.field_of_member,
        jt.loai_du_lieu_bc,
        jt.bang_du_lieu_bc,
        jt.cot_du_lieu_bc
    FROM output_form of_
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET fs ON fs.FORM_REPORT_ID = of_.form_report_id
    LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET_CELL fscell ON fscell.FORM_SHEET_ID = fs.ID
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        fscell.FORMULA, '$'
        COLUMNS (
            formula_key VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].key',
            member_profile_type VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].memberProfileType',
            field_of_member VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].fieldOfMember',
            loai_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].loaiDuLieuBc',
            bang_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].bangDuLieuBc',
            cot_du_lieu_bc  VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cotDuLieuBc'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE fscell.ID IS NOT NULL
      AND jt.member_profile_type = 'LS_PGD_CTCK'
),
-- Lấy dữ liệu từ SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE, parse AFTER_DATA_JSON
profile_change AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ID AS change_id,
        pc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID,
        pc.ENTITY_TYPE,
        -- Parse các trường từ AFTER_DATA_JSON
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.id') AS pgd_id,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenCtck') AS tenCtck,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenDayDu') AS tenDayDu,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.diaChi') AS diaChi,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenTinhThanh') AS tenTinhThanh,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.ctckChiNhanhTen') AS ctckChiNhanhTen,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenTrangThaiPgd') AS tenTrangThaiPgd,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.nghiepVuHoTro') AS nghiepVuHoTro
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE pc
    WHERE pc.ENTITY_TYPE = 'PGD'   -- Phòng giao dịch
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
        DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, pc.change_id) AS stt_ctck,
    -- CHIỀU / BỘ LỌC
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,
    pc.change_id,
    pc.ENTITY_TYPE,
    -- GIÁ TRỊ
    oc.FORMULA_TEXT AS ma_chi_tieu,
    oc.field_of_member AS ten_chi_tieu,
    CASE oc.field_of_member
        WHEN 'tenCtck' THEN pc.tenCtck
        WHEN 'tenDayDu' THEN pc.tenDayDu
        WHEN 'diaChi' THEN pc.diaChi
        WHEN 'tenTinhThanh' THEN pc.tenTinhThanh
        WHEN 'ctckChiNhanhTen' THEN pc.ctckChiNhanhTen
        WHEN 'tenTrangThaiPgd' THEN pc.tenTrangThaiPgd
        WHEN 'nghiepVuHoTro' THEN pc.nghiepVuHoTro
        ELSE NULL
    END AS gia_tri
FROM profile_change pc
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = pc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
CROSS JOIN output_cells oc
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, pc.change_id, oc.cell_id;

    LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET_CELL fscell ON fscell.FORM_SHEET_ID = fs.ID
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        fscell.FORMULA, '$'
        COLUMNS (
            formula_key VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].key',
            member_profile_type VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].memberProfileType',
            field_of_member VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].fieldOfMember',
            su_vu_id NUMBER PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].suVuId',
            rpt_id NUMBER PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].rptId',
            cell_sheet_id VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].sheetId',
            catalog_cell_id VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cellsMeta.catalogCellId',
            section_id VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cellsMeta.sectionId',
            loai_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].loaiDuLieuBc',
            bang_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].bangDuLieuBc',
            cot_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cotDuLieuBc'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE fscell.ID IS NOT NULL
      AND jt.member_profile_type = 'LS_CTCK'    
),
-- Lấy dữ liệu từ SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE, parse AFTER_DATA_JSON
profile_change AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ID AS change_id,
        pc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID,
        pc.ENTITY_TYPE,
        -- Parse các trường từ AFTER_DATA_JSON
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenTiengViet') AS tenTiengViet,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.diaChi') AS diaChi,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.dienThoai') AS dienThoai,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.soGpTlhdLanDau') AS soGpTlhdLanDau,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.ngayCapGpTlhdLanDau') AS ngayCapGpTlhdLanDau,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.maCongTy') AS maCongTy,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.sanNiemYet') AS sanNiemYet,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.maChungKhoan') AS maChungKhoan,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.vonDieuLe') AS vonDieuLe,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.website') AS website,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenTrangThai') AS tenTrangThai,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.nganhNgheKinhDoanh') AS nganhNgheKinhDoanh,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.soVanBan') AS soVanBan,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.nganhNgheKinhDoanhPhaiSinh') AS nganhNgheKinhDoanhPhaiSinh
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE pc
    WHERE pc.ENTITY_TYPE = 'TRU_SO_CHINH'   -- CTCK
),
-- Lấy form_report_id của báo cáo INPUT tương ứng
input_submissions AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.FORM_REPORT_ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID
                                  ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT rpt_id FROM output_cells WHERE rpt_id IS NOT NULL)
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Lấy cell value từ INPUT tương ứng
input_cell_values AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT cell_sheet_id FROM output_cells WHERE cell_sheet_id IS NOT NULL)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM input_submissions)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME,
                 NVL(TO_CHAR(pc.change_id), TO_CHAR(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID)),
                 p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    ) AS stt,
    -- CHIỀU / BỘ LỌC
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,   
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    oc.SHEET_CODE, oc.SHEET_NAME,
    oc.section_id,
    -- MÃ / TÊN CHỈ TIÊU
    oc.FORMULA_TEXT AS ma_ct,
    oc.catalog_cell_id AS ma_ct_input,	
    oc.field_of_member AS ten_chi_tieu_output,
    oc.cot_du_lieu_bc,
    m.ROW_NAME AS ten_hang_input,
    m.COLUMN_NAME AS ten_cot_input,
    icv.ROW_NO,
    -- GIÁ TRỊ: ưu tiên INPUT nếu có, fallback SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE
    CASE
        WHEN oc.rpt_id IS NOT NULL THEN icv.ITEM_VALUE  -- Chỉ tiêu từ báo cáo đầu vào          
        ELSE
            -- Chỉ tiêu từ SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE
            CASE oc.field_of_member
                WHEN 'tenTiengViet' THEN pc.tenTiengViet
                WHEN 'diaChi' THEN pc.diaChi
                WHEN 'dienThoai' THEN pc.dienThoai
                WHEN 'soGpTlhdLanDau' THEN pc.soGpTlhdLanDau
                WHEN 'ngayCapGpTlhdLanDau' THEN pc.ngayCapGpTlhdLanDau
                WHEN 'maCongTy' THEN pc.maCongTy
                WHEN 'sanNiemYet' THEN pc.sanNiemYet
                WHEN 'maChungKhoan' THEN pc.maChungKhoan
                WHEN 'vonDieuLe' THEN pc.vonDieuLe
                WHEN 'website' THEN pc.website
                WHEN 'tenTrangThai' THEN pc.tenTrangThai
                WHEN 'nganhNgheKinhDoanh' THEN pc.nganhNgheKinhDoanh
                WHEN 'soVanBan' THEN pc.soVanBan
                WHEN 'nganhNgheKinhDoanhPhaiSinh' THEN pc.nganhNgheKinhDoanhPhaiSinh
                ELSE NULL
            END
    END AS gia_tri,
    icv.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM output_cells oc
LEFT JOIN input_submissions sub ON sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = oc.rpt_id
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
LEFT JOIN input_cell_values icv ON icv.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
                                AND icv.SHEET_ID = oc.cell_sheet_id
                                AND icv.CELL_ID = oc.catalog_cell_id
--                                AND icv.SECTION_ID = oc.section_id
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = icv.SHEET_ID
                            AND m.CELLID = icv.CELL_ID
--                            AND m.SECTIONID = icv.SECTION_ID
                            AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = sub.FORM_REPORT_ID
-- Nhánh SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE (chỉ với chỉ tiêu không từ INPUT)
LEFT JOIN profile_change pc ON pc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.ID
                            AND oc.rpt_id IS NULL
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         oc.SHEET_CODE, oc.cell_id, icv.ROW_NO;

    fscell.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    fscell.FORMULA_TEXT AS ma_chi_tieu,
    jt.catalog_cell_id AS ma_chi_tieu_input,
    jt.field_of_member AS ten_chi_tieu,
    jt.cot_du_lieu_bc,
    m.ROW_NAME AS ten_hang_input,
    m.COLUMN_NAME AS ten_cot_input
FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET fs ON fs.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET_CELL fscell ON fscell.FORM_SHEET_ID = fs.ID
CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
    fscell.FORMULA, '$'
    COLUMNS (
        rpt_id NUMBER PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].rptId',
        cell_sheet_id VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].sheetId',
        catalog_cell_id VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cellsMeta.catalogCellId',
        section_id      VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cellsMeta.sectionId',
        field_of_member VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].fieldOfMember',
        cot_du_lieu_bc  VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cotDuLieuBc'
    )
) jt
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m
    ON  m.CELLID = jt.catalog_cell_id
    AND m.SHEETID = jt.cell_sheet_id
    AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = jt.rpt_id
WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'DG_DTDKCPTLHD'
  AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'OUTPUT'
  AND fscell.ID IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY fscell.ID;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH output_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id, fr.REPORT_CODE, fr.REPORT_NAME
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'DG_DTDKCPTLHD'       -- Mã báo cáo
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'OUTPUT'
),
-- Lấy cấu hình sheet/row/col/cell của báo cáo đầu ra
output_cells AS (
    SELECT
        fs.ID AS form_sheet_id,
        fs.SHEET_CODE, fs.SHEET_NAME,
        fscell.ID AS cell_id,
        fscell.FORM_REPORT_ID,
        fscell.CELL_CODE,
        fscell.DATA_TYPE,
        fscell.FORMULA,
        fscell.FORMULA_TEXT,
        -- Parse FORMULA JSON
        jt.formula_key,
        jt.member_profile_type,
        jt.field_of_member,
        jt.su_vu_id,
        jt.rpt_id,
        jt.cell_sheet_id,
        jt.catalog_cell_id,
        jt.section_id,
        jt.loai_du_lieu_bc,
        jt.bang_du_lieu_bc,
        jt.cot_du_lieu_bc
    FROM output_form of_
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET fs ON fs.FORM_REPORT_ID = of_.form_report_id
    LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET_CELL fscell ON fscell.FORM_SHEET_ID = fs.ID
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        fscell.FORMULA, '$'
        COLUMNS (
            formula_key VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].key',
            member_profile_type VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].memberProfileType',
            field_of_member VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].fieldOfMember',
            su_vu_id NUMBER PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].suVuId',
            rpt_id NUMBER PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].rptId',
            cell_sheet_id VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].sheetId',
            catalog_cell_id VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cellsMeta.catalogCellId',
            section_id VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cellsMeta.sectionId',
            loai_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].loaiDuLieuBc',
            bang_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].bangDuLieuBc',
            cot_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cotDuLieuBc'
        )
    ) jt
    WHERE fscell.ID IS NOT NULL
      AND jt.member_profile_type = 'LS_CTCK'    
),
-- Lấy dữ liệu từ SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE, parse AFTER_DATA_JSON
profile_change AS (
    SELECT
        pc.ID AS change_id,
        pc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID,
        pc.ENTITY_TYPE,
        -- Parse các trường từ AFTER_DATA_JSON
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenTiengViet') AS tenTiengViet,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.diaChi') AS diaChi,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.dienThoai') AS dienThoai,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.soGpTlhdLanDau') AS soGpTlhdLanDau,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.ngayCapGpTlhdLanDau') AS ngayCapGpTlhdLanDau,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.maCongTy') AS maCongTy,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.sanNiemYet') AS sanNiemYet,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.maChungKhoan') AS maChungKhoan,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.vonDieuLe') AS vonDieuLe,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.website') AS website,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.tenTrangThai') AS tenTrangThai,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.nganhNgheKinhDoanh') AS nganhNgheKinhDoanh,
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.soVanBan') AS soVanBan,  -- AFTER_DATA_JSON đang không có soVanBan và suVuTen
        JSON_VALUE(pc.AFTER_DATA_JSON, '$.nganhNgheKinhDoanhPhaiSinh') AS nganhNgheKinhDoanhPhaiSinh
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE pc
    WHERE pc.ENTITY_TYPE = 'TRU_SO_CHINH'   -- CTCK
),
-- Lấy form_report_id của báo cáo INPUT tương ứng
input_submissions AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.FORM_REPORT_ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID
                                  ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT rpt_id FROM output_cells WHERE rpt_id IS NOT NULL)
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Lấy cell value từ INPUT tương ứng
input_cell_values AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT cell_sheet_id FROM output_cells WHERE cell_sheet_id IS NOT NULL)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM input_submissions)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME,
                 NVL(TO_CHAR(pc.change_id), TO_CHAR(p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID)),
                 p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD
    ) AS stt,
    -- CHIỀU / BỘ LỌC
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,   
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    oc.SHEET_CODE, oc.SHEET_NAME,
    oc.section_id,
    -- MÃ / TÊN CHỈ TIÊU
    oc.FORMULA_TEXT AS ma_ct,
    oc.catalog_cell_id AS ma_ct_input,	
    oc.field_of_member AS ten_chi_tieu_output,
    oc.cot_du_lieu_bc,
    m.ROW_NAME AS ten_hang_input,
    m.COLUMN_NAME AS ten_cot_input,
    icv.ROW_NO,
    -- GIÁ TRỊ: ưu tiên INPUT nếu có, fallback SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE
    CASE
        WHEN oc.rpt_id IS NOT NULL THEN icv.ITEM_VALUE  -- Chỉ tiêu từ báo cáo đầu vào          
        ELSE
            -- Chỉ tiêu từ SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE
            CASE oc.field_of_member
                WHEN 'tenTiengViet' THEN pc.tenTiengViet
                WHEN 'diaChi' THEN pc.diaChi
                WHEN 'dienThoai' THEN pc.dienThoai
                WHEN 'soGpTlhdLanDau' THEN pc.soGpTlhdLanDau
                WHEN 'ngayCapGpTlhdLanDau' THEN pc.ngayCapGpTlhdLanDau
                WHEN 'maCongTy' THEN pc.maCongTy
                WHEN 'sanNiemYet' THEN pc.sanNiemYet
                WHEN 'maChungKhoan' THEN pc.maChungKhoan
                WHEN 'vonDieuLe' THEN pc.vonDieuLe
                WHEN 'website' THEN pc.website
                WHEN 'tenTrangThai' THEN pc.tenTrangThai
                WHEN 'nganhNgheKinhDoanh' THEN pc.nganhNgheKinhDoanh
                WHEN 'soVanBan' THEN pc.soVanBan
                WHEN 'nganhNgheKinhDoanhPhaiSinh' THEN pc.nganhNgheKinhDoanhPhaiSinh
                ELSE NULL
            END
    END AS gia_tri,
    icv.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM output_cells oc
LEFT JOIN input_submissions sub ON sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = oc.rpt_id
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
LEFT JOIN input_cell_values icv ON icv.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
                                AND icv.SHEET_ID = oc.cell_sheet_id
                                AND icv.CELL_ID = oc.catalog_cell_id
--                                AND icv.SECTION_ID = oc.section_id
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = icv.SHEET_ID
                            AND m.CELLID = icv.CELL_ID
--                            AND m.SECTIONID = icv.SECTION_ID
                            AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = sub.FORM_REPORT_ID
-- Nhánh SC_FIRM_PROFILE_CHANGE (chỉ với chỉ tiêu không từ INPUT)
LEFT JOIN profile_change pc ON pc.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.ID
                            AND oc.rpt_id IS NULL
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         oc.SHEET_CODE, oc.cell_id, icv.ROW_NO;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'PNRRVSLCQCDB'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '01'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'PNRRVSLCQCDB'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '02A'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '02B'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU

-- SEC_1
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'CQCDB'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '01'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- SEC_2
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'CQCDB'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '01'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_2'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')

JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section

-- CHỈ TIÊU

-- SEC_1
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'CQCDB'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '02'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- SEC_2
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'CQCDB'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '02'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_2'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'CQCDB'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '03'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

SELECT
    fr.ID AS form_report_id,
    fr.REPORT_CODE AS ma_bao_cao,
    fr.REPORT_NAME AS ten_bao_cao,
    fr.REPORT_TYPE AS loai_bao_cao,
    fr.VERSION,
    jt.ky_ap_dung AS ky_bao_cao,
    jt.sheetCode AS ma_sheet,
    jt.sheetName AS ten_sheet
FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
     ON dc.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE (
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode',
            sheetName VARCHAR2(500) PATH '$.sheetName',
            ky_ap_dung VARCHAR2(2000) FORMAT JSON PATH '$.kyApDung'
        )
     ) jt ON 1 = 1
WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCHDPS'  -- Mã báo cáo
  AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
  AND fr.RECORD_STATUS IN (1,2) -- Đúng hạn, Gửi muộn
  AND jt.sheetCode = '01';

-- CHỈ TIÊU

-- SEC_1
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCHDPS'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '01'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;
