-- SEC_2
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCHDPS'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '01'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_2'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_2'
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- SEC_4
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCHDPS'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '01'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_4'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_4'
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCHDPS'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '02'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCHDPS'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '03'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- SEC_2
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCHDPS'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '04'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_2'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_2'
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCHDPS'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '05'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'TTC_N'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'TTC_Q'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL

    SELECT jt.sheetId

                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'

    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,

FROM latest_submission sub

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.1'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

SELECT
    fr.ID AS form_report_id,
    fr.REPORT_CODE AS ma_bao_cao,
    fr.REPORT_NAME AS ten_bao_cao,
    fr.REPORT_TYPE AS loai_bao_cao,
    fr.VERSION,
    jt.ky_ap_dung AS ky_bao_cao,
    jt.sheetCode AS ma_sheet,
    jt.sheetName AS ten_sheet
FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
     ON dc.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE (
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode',
            sheetName VARCHAR2(500) PATH '$.sheetName',
            ky_ap_dung VARCHAR2(2000) FORMAT JSON PATH '$.kyApDung'
        )
     ) jt ON 1 = 1
WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'  -- Mã báo cáo
  AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
  AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.2';

        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1

    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1

cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)

nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'

                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.3'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.4'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.9'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.13'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- Mã sheet / Tên sheet
SELECT
    fr.ID AS form_report_id,
    fr.REPORT_CODE AS ma_bao_cao,
    fr.REPORT_NAME AS ten_bao_cao,
    fr.REPORT_TYPE AS loai_bao_cao,
    fr.VERSION,
    jt.ky_ap_dung AS ky_bao_cao,
    jt.sheetCode AS ma_sheet,
    jt.sheetName AS ten_sheet
FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
     ON dc.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE (
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode',
            sheetName VARCHAR2(500) PATH '$.sheetName',
            ky_ap_dung VARCHAR2(2000) FORMAT JSON PATH '$.kyApDung'
        )
     ) jt ON 1 = 1
WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'  -- Mã báo cáo
  AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
  AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.8B';

WITH input_form AS (

      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.8B'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT

    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.7'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.10'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTHHD_CTCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.11'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;
