-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'QTCT'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'NNB_NCLQNNB'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'QTCT'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'CVDK'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH output_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id, fr.REPORT_CODE, fr.REPORT_NAME
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'NPF'       -- Mã báo cáo
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'OUTPUT'
),
-- Lấy cấu hình sheet/row/col/cell của báo cáo đầu ra
output_cells AS (
    SELECT
        fs.ID AS form_sheet_id,
        fs.SHEET_CODE, fs.SHEET_NAME,
        fscell.ID AS cell_id,
        fscell.FORM_REPORT_ID,
        fscell.CELL_CODE,
        fscell.DATA_TYPE,
        fscell.FORMULA,
        fscell.FORMULA_TEXT,
        -- Parse FORMULA JSON
        jt.formula_key,
        jt.member_profile_type,
        jt.field_of_member,
        jt.su_vu_id,
        jt.rpt_id,
        jt.cell_sheet_id,
        jt.catalog_cell_id,
        jt.section_id,
        jt.loai_du_lieu_bc,
        jt.bang_du_lieu_bc,
        jt.cot_du_lieu_bc
    FROM output_form of_
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET fs ON fs.FORM_REPORT_ID = of_.form_report_id
    LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_SHEET_CELL fscell ON fscell.FORM_SHEET_ID = fs.ID
    CROSS JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        fscell.FORMULA, '$'
        COLUMNS (
            formula_key VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].key',
            member_profile_type VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].memberProfileType',
            field_of_member VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].fieldOfMember',
            su_vu_id NUMBER PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].suVuId',
            rpt_id NUMBER PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].rptId',
            cell_sheet_id VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].sheetId',
            catalog_cell_id VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cellsMeta.catalogCellId',
            section_id VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cellsMeta.sectionId',
            loai_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].loaiDuLieuBc',
            bang_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].bangDuLieuBc',
            cot_du_lieu_bc VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.forMulaObjectInfos[0].cotDuLieuBc'
        )
    ) jt
),
-- Lấy form_report_id của báo cáo INPUT tương ứng
input_submissions AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.FORM_REPORT_ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID
                                  ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
          AND sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT rpt_id FROM output_cells WHERE rpt_id IS NOT NULL)
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
-- Lấy cell value từ INPUT tương ứng
input_cell_values AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT cell_sheet_id FROM output_cells)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM input_submissions)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                               AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                               AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, oc.SHEET_CODE
    ) AS stt,
    -- CHIỀU / BỘ LỌC
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    oc.SHEET_CODE, oc.SHEET_NAME,
    oc.section_id,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU
    c.NAME_VI AS "Tên công ty chứng khoán",
    TO_CHAR(p.SENT_AT, 'MM/DD/YYYY') AS "Ngày",
    oc.FORMULA_TEXT AS ma_ct,
    oc.catalog_cell_id AS ma_ct_input,     
    oc.field_of_member AS ten_chi_tieu_output,
    oc.cot_du_lieu_bc,
    m.ROW_NAME AS ten_hang_input,
    m.COLUMN_NAME AS ten_cot_input,
    icv.ROW_NO,
    m.UNITSCALE,
    icv.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    icv.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM output_cells oc
LEFT JOIN input_submissions sub ON sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = oc.rpt_id
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
LEFT JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
LEFT JOIN input_cell_values icv ON icv.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
                                AND icv.SHEET_ID = oc.cell_sheet_id
                                AND icv.CELL_ID = oc.catalog_cell_id
--                                AND icv.SECTION_ID = oc.section_id
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = icv.SHEET_ID
                            AND m.CELLID = icv.CELL_ID
--                            AND m.SECTIONID = icv.SECTION_ID
                            AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = sub.FORM_REPORT_ID                                
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         oc.SHEET_CODE, oc.CELL_CODE, icv.ROW_NO;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'I.3.1'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'I.3.2'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'I.3.3'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.2.1'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)

        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (

        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)

),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'

                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX

    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,

JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID

LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.3.b'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.5.a'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'II.5.d'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'V.Ia'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'V.Ic'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'V.Ie'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'V.IIa'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub

      )

sheet AS (

    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc

        COLUMNS (

        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)

),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '

LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTN'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'V.IIIc'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_CAT_INDICATOR_INPUT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        SUBSTR(civ.ITEM_VALUE, 1, 4000) AS ITEM_VALUE
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- Báo cáo của tổ chức tư vấn hồ sơ chào bán trái phiếu >> Kết quả rà soát điều kiện, hồ sơ chào bán trái phiếu đối với các hợp đồng đã  hoàn thành
-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTVHSCBTP'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '02'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        SUBSTR(civ.ITEM_VALUE, 1, 4000) AS ITEM_VALUE
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
),
nganh_nghe AS (
    SELECT
        c.ID AS sc_firm_info_id,
        LISTAGG(
            CASE sl.CATALOG_CODE
                WHEN N'MG'   THEN N'Môi giới'
                WHEN N'TD'   THEN N'Tự doanh'
                WHEN N'BLPH' THEN N'Bảo lãnh phát hành'
                WHEN N'TVDT' THEN N'Tư vấn đầu tư'
                WHEN N'02'   THEN N'Giao dịch ký quỹ'
                WHEN N'01'   THEN N'Ứng trước tiền bán'
                WHEN N'04'   THEN N'Lưu ký'
            END, ', '
        ) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY sl.CATALOG_CODE) AS nganh_nghe
    FROM SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.LNK_SC_FIRM_SERVICE lnk ON lnk.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID = c.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
    JOIN SCMS_UAT.CAT_SERVICE_LEGAL_CAPITAL sl ON sl.SERVICE_ID = lnk.SERVICE_ID
                                                           AND sl.RECORD_STATUS = 1
                                                           AND sl.CATALOG_CODE IN (N'MG',N'TD',N'BLPH',N'TVDT',N'02',N'01',N'04')
    GROUP BY c.ID
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    c.SHORT_NAME AS ten_ctck,
    c.LISTING_EXCHANGE AS san_giao_dich,
    nn.nganh_nghe,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_INFO c ON c.ID = p.SC_FIRM_INFO_ID
LEFT JOIN nganh_nghe nn ON nn.sc_firm_info_id = c.ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY c.SHORT_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTCRL'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06618'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY b.BRANCH_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    b.BRANCH_NAME AS ten_chi_nhanh_nuoc_ngoai,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
