-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTLAT'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06H07'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY b.BRANCH_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    b.BRANCH_NAME AS ten_chi_nhanh_nuoc_ngoai,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_FOREIGN_BRANCH_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_FOREIGN_BRANCH b ON b.ID = p.SC_FIRM_FOREIGN_BRANCH_ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
					AND sub.REF_TYPE = 'CTCK_CN_NN_BAO_CAO_DINH_KY'
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = sub.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY b.BRANCH_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'BCTLAT'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '06H08'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID, FORM_REPORT_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID, sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY b.BRANCH_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    b.BRANCH_NAME AS ten_chi_nhanh_nuoc_ngoai,    
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    sub.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_FOREIGN_BRANCH_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.SC_FIRM_FOREIGN_BRANCH b ON b.ID = p.SC_FIRM_FOREIGN_BRANCH_ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
					AND sub.REF_TYPE = 'CTCK_CN_NN_BAO_CAO_DINH_KY'
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = sub.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY b.BRANCH_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- Mã BC / Tên BC / Loại BC / Kỳ BC (chiều DWH – dùng chung)
-- Mã sheet / Tên sheet
SELECT
    fr.ID AS form_report_id,
    fr.REPORT_CODE AS ma_bao_cao,
    fr.REPORT_NAME AS ten_bao_cao,
    fr.REPORT_TYPE AS loai_bao_cao,
    fr.VERSION,
    jt.ky_ap_dung AS ky_bao_cao,
    jt.sheetCode AS ma_sheet,
    jt.sheetName AS ten_sheet
FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
JOIN SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
     ON dc.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE (
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode',
            sheetName VARCHAR2(500) PATH '$.sheetName',
            ky_ap_dung VARCHAR2(2000) FORMAT JSON PATH '$.kyApDung'
        )
     ) jt ON 1 = 1
WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'GSTSBD'  -- Mã báo cáo
  AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
  AND jt.sheetCode = '1';

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'GSTSBD'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = '1'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY b.BANK_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    b.BANK_NAME AS ten_nhlk,   
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.BANK_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.BANK b ON b.ID = p.BANK_ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY b.BANK_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'DDKLNHTT'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'S1'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY b.BANK_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    b.BANK_NAME AS ten_nhtt,   
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.BANK_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.BANK b ON b.ID = p.BANK_ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY b.BANK_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;

-- CHỈ TIÊU
WITH input_form AS (
    SELECT fr.ID AS form_report_id
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT fr
    WHERE fr.REPORT_CODE = 'HDTTTGDCK'
      AND fr.REPORT_TYPE = 'INPUT'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
          WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID = fr.ID
            AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
      )
),
sheet AS (
    SELECT jt.sheetId
    FROM SCMS_UAT.FORM_REPORT_DEEP_CONFIG dc
    LEFT JOIN JSON_TABLE(
        dc.SHEETS_JSON, '$[*]'
        COLUMNS (
            sheetId   VARCHAR2(200) PATH '$.sheetId',
            sheetCode VARCHAR2(100) PATH '$.sheetCode'
        )
    ) jt ON 1 = 1
    WHERE dc.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
      AND jt.sheetCode = 'CT'
),
latest_submission AS (
    SELECT ID, REF_TYPE, REF_ID
    FROM (
        SELECT sub.ID, sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY sub.REF_TYPE, sub.REF_ID ORDER BY sub.ID DESC) AS rn
        FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION sub
        WHERE sub.FORM_REPORT_ID IN (SELECT form_report_id FROM input_form)
          AND sub.REF_TYPE IS NOT NULL
    ) WHERE rn = 1
),
cell_data AS (
    SELECT
        civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID,
        civ.SHEET_ID,
        civ.CELL_ID,
        civ.ROW_NO,
        civ.SECTION_ID,
        CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) AS ITEM_VALUE,
        TO_NUMBER(CAST(civ.ITEM_VALUE AS VARCHAR2(4000)) DEFAULT NULL ON CONVERSION ERROR) AS numeric_value
    FROM SCMS_UAT.REPORT_INPUT_CELL_VALUE civ
    WHERE civ.SHEET_ID IN (SELECT sheetId FROM sheet)
      AND civ.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID IN (SELECT ID FROM latest_submission)
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
        ORDER BY b.BANK_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD, cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX
    ) AS stt,
    b.BANK_NAME AS ten_nhtt,   
    p.REPORT_PERIOD AS loai_ky,
    p.PERIOD || '/' || p.REPORT_YEAR AS ky_du_lieu,
    p.FORM_REPORT_ID,
    -- CHỈ TIÊU từ bảng FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT
    m.SHEETID AS ma_sheet,
    m.SECTIONID AS ma_section,
    cd.ROW_NO AS row_no,
    m.CELLID AS ma_chi_tieu,
    m.row_name AS ten_hang,
    m.column_name AS ten_cot,
    cd.ITEM_VALUE AS gia_tri,
    cd.numeric_value AS gia_tri_so
FROM latest_submission sub
JOIN SCMS_UAT.BANK_PERIODIC_REPORT p ON p.ID = sub.REF_ID
JOIN SCMS_UAT.BANK b ON b.ID = p.BANK_ID
JOIN cell_data cd ON cd.REPORT_INPUT_SUBMISSION_ID = sub.ID
LEFT JOIN FSS.SCMS_MAP_CT m ON m.SHEETID = cd.SHEET_ID
                                         AND m.CELLID = cd.CELL_ID
                                         AND m.FORM_REPORT_ID = p.FORM_REPORT_ID 
--                                         AND cd.SECTION_ID = m.SECTIONID  -- Với biểu mẫu chứa nhiều section
--                                         AND m.SECTIONID = 'SEC_1'
WHERE p.RECORD_STATUS IN (1, 2)
--  AND p.REPORT_PERIOD = 'NGAY'
--  AND p.PERIOD = 1 
--  AND p.REPORT_YEAR = 2024
ORDER BY b.BANK_NAME, p.REPORT_PERIOD, p.REPORT_YEAR, p.PERIOD,
         cd.ROW_NO, m.ROWINDEX, m.COLINDEX;
